newsitem.title: USA: SEACOR SMIT buys into Chiles rig venture.
newsitem.headline: SEACOR SMIT buys into Chiles rig venture.

text.p: SEACOR SMIT Inc is to take a 50 percent stake privately-held Chiles Offshore LLC, a limited partnership which will own and operate offshore drilling rigs.
SEACOR will pay $9.0 million for the stake and invest an additional $26 million in the limited partnership.

Chiles said in a statement that it had ordered a second jackup rig capable of working in water depths up to 350 feet from the Amfels Inc shipyard which will be capable of working in all but the harshest environments.
"Chiles offshore intends to order additional rigs and syndicate units in the rig-owning partnerships," the companies said.

Dayrates for jackup rigs have risen dramatically over the past few years as demand exceeds supply but shares in the industry were jolted earlier this year when industry analysts warned that new builds could hurt dayrates, although they have since recovered.
"Demand is outstripping supply and whether we order another two, three, four, five or six rigs, that is noty going to alter the balance," Bill Chiles said in a telephone interview.
He said that the first rig would be ready in 18 months, the second in 24 months.

The limited partnership proposed means that investors will benefit directly from cash flows and also realize any potential capital appreciation in a tax efficient way, Chiles said. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
